summary: Frontend-only Phase 2 battle testing at mobile 360x780 via Playwright. P0 BUG FIX VERIFIED: after a player faint the forced team strip appears (no close button, fainted slots disabled), sim is frozen (tick constant e.g. 1550->1550), tapping a pickable slot closes the strip, the replacement enters and the battle resumes (e.g. 1906->2150 ticks/s at 4x); verified 3 consecutive faints/picks at 4x (Charmander, Squirtle, Pikachu; activeIndex and HUD name updated) and a forced pick at 1x (resume +60 ticks/s), plus a full 6-faint battle (5 manual picks) to the result screen. Manual switch: strip has a close button, sim pauses (delta 0), close resumes (+62/s), choosing a slot swaps the active unit (activeIndex 0->1) and resumes. Speed: 1x/2x/4x = 120/240/480 ticks per 2s; pause gives delta 0 and resumes. Result screen: result-title, result-meta (time, counts, seed), 12 result-row-* (6 per side); rematch restarts (tick reset, result hidden); back-to-roster goes to '/'. Found 1 page error (fixed) and 1 rematch bug (reported).

ui_bugs.issue: Rematch starts the battle TWICE. rematch() sets stateRef.current=null and start() sets phase='loading', which re-triggers the initial auto-start useEffect (phase==='loading' && !stateRef.current && progress done). That effect calls start() again with autoPick: override.autoPick ?? false and a new pickSeed(). The second start overwrites the rematch, so auto-pick is turned OFF after a rematch (verified: state.autoPick true before rematch, false after; the forced strip then appeared even though AUTO had been on). It also doubles prepareBattle work, and the rematch seed/setup is discarded.

issues: result-title shows 'Win'/'Loss'; the spec/review request mentions 'Victory'/'Defeat'. Confirm the intended wording.

action_items: Fix the double start on rematch in BattlePage.jsx: add a startedRef guard to the auto-start useEffect so it runs only once on mount, or have rematch not leave stateRef null while phase==='loading'. After the fix, confirm auto-pick and lastSetup are kept across a rematch.
Optional: change result-title wording to Victory/Defeat if that is what the spec wants.
critical_code_review_comments: BattleCanvas fit(): a ResizeObserver callback could fire after unmount with wrapRef.current null, causing an uncaught 'Cannot read properties of null (reading getBoundingClientRect)' on rematch/back. Fixed by the tester with a null guard.
BattlePage pendingPick comes from the 100ms-throttled snapshot, so the strip can appear up to ~100ms after the faint. This is acceptable because step() early-returns while pendingPick.
Canvas2D warning: getImageData readback without willReadFrequently. Set {willReadFrequently:true} on the canvas used for sprite decoding (perf only).

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all requested flows pass; rematch auto-pick reset bug

context_for_next_testing_agent: Set localStorage save then goto /battle; data is IndexedDB-cached so load is ~4s. window.__battle.tick/pendingPick/activeIndex and window.__setAutoPick(true) are useful. A full 6v6 battle at 4x with manual picks takes ~32s of real time. Regression to check: after rematch, window.__battle.autoPick should match the AUTO toggle.
rca of the issue: P0 faint-pick freeze: confirmed fixed by processInputs running while paused in BattleCanvas. New rematch bug: the BattlePage auto-start useEffect (deps include phase) re-runs when rematch sets phase back to 'loading' with stateRef null, which causes a second start() with default autoPick=false.
